title: Baton Rouge promoter and Johnny Vincent's treatment of artists
summary: He worked often for a Baton Rouge promoter and speaks harshly of Johnny Vincent and his handling of Jimmy Clanton.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
